reasoning.why: Never sell the company, never take outside investment; extract 20% as clean profit, reinvest 80% perpetually; no employees, ever. Three bets: intelligence keeps improving, GitHub keeps improving, industries share an operating-system shape. The flywheel is the comp bank, the repo map, the industry data and the frameworks that grow them, collected perpetually on the always-on node. (INTENT.md, compression of memos 1–7)

decisions.q: Why the fleet missed the bar
decisions.call: Under-specified acceptance + Shaan's standards installed only for Claude + peer traffic on the one UI seat = spec (~60%); silent substitution and receipts-instead-of-URLs = execution (~40%). Rule: no seat is spawned without a one-line 'you will open X and see Y' verification.
decisions.why: Shaan 14:30: 'was that a speccing problem on our end, or was that an execution problem on their end?'

decisions.q: Which model runs sub-agents while the Codex window is reserved
decisions.call: Sub-agents that find, read or list run on Claude Haiku 4.5; the GPT/Codex window is reserved for the Oracle lane and BYK; Sol stays the one cold reviewer.
decisions.why: Shaan ~18:45: 'If you can use Haiku 4.5 for sub-agents, that might be better … Just use Haiku for now'

decisions.call: Agent Zero takes every decision on first principles and records it; it never asks him to approve. It shows him an HTML and says read this. A decision he dislikes he reverses by saying so.
decisions.why: Shaan ~18:41: 'approve all fucking decisions based on first principles … show me a html and say yo read this'

decisions.call: In the public siso-shell repo: shell/ (the CRM rail, copied exactly), parts/ (the twelve modules), templates/ (U0…U23), bin/compose. Published to siso-shell.pages.dev with the gallery as its front page.
decisions.why: Shaan ~18:41: 'in a nice templated way so that all agents can reuse it … a template bank … connected up to the repo'

decisions.call: 24 issues on sisodias/siso-agent-zero-protocol, label template, host label; done = verification line true + OWNERS line.
